SELECT s.id AS id, s.name AS name, s.display_name AS display_name, s.card_excerpt AS card_excerpt, s.download_count AS download_count, s.like_count AS like_count, s.favorite_count AS favorite_count, s.updated_at AS updated_at, s.owner_user_id AS owner_user_id, ou.display_name AS owner_display_name, ou.employee_no AS owner_employee_no, sv.id AS latest_version_id, sv.version AS latest_version_version, sv.certification AS latest_version_certification FROM skill s LEFT JOIN app_user ou ON ou.id = s.owner_user_id LEFT JOIN skill_version sv ON sv.id = s.latest_version_id
ORDER BY ${sortColumn} DESC, s.id DESC LIMIT #{limit} OFFSET #{offset}
SELECT count(*) FROM skill s LEFT JOIN skill_version sv ON sv.id = s.latest_version_id

SELECT s.id, s.name, s.display_name, s.description, s.source, s.card_excerpt, s.status, s.download_count, s.like_count, s.dislike_count, s.favorite_count, s.comment_count, s.created_at, s.updated_at, s.owner_user_id AS owner_user_id, ou.display_name AS owner_display_name, ou.employee_no AS owner_employee_no, sv.id AS latest_version_id, sv.version AS latest_version_version, sv.size_bytes AS latest_version_size_bytes, sv.file_count AS latest_version_file_count, sv.allowed_tools AS latest_version_allowed_tools, sv.skill_md_content AS latest_version_skill_md_content, sv.readme_content AS latest_version_readme_content, sv.changelog AS latest_version_changelog, sv.certification AS latest_version_certification, sv.certified_by_user_id AS latest_version_certified_by_user_id, sv.certified_at AS latest_version_certified_at, sv.certify_note AS latest_version_certify_note, sv.created_by_user_id AS latest_version_created_by_user_id, sv.created_at AS latest_version_created_at FROM skill s LEFT JOIN app_user ou ON ou.id = s.owner_user_id LEFT JOIN skill_version sv ON sv.id = s.latest_version_id WHERE s.id = #{skillId}
SELECT count(*) FROM skill WHERE id = #{skillId}

SELECT id, version, size_bytes, file_count, certification, certified_by_user_id, certified_at, certify_note, created_by_user_id, created_at FROM skill_version WHERE skill_id = #{skillId} ORDER BY created_at DESC, id DESC
